events.subtitle: 75th Anniversary — Nobuo Hara Centenary

priority_review.rationale: Concrete scarcity: the November 27 concert is explicitly billed as both Sharps & Flats' 75th anniversary and founder Nobuo Hara's centenary. Hara founded the band in 1951 and died in 2021; HARA Music Japan restarted the ensemble in 2024 around veteran members and the surviving repertory. That exact 75-years/100-years historical conjunction cannot recur. A+ was explicitly challenged and judged insufficient because, for a listener already in Greater Tokyo/Kanto, missing this date means missing the centenary performance context itself, even though the revived band has other 2026 appearances. The recommendation is to protect the night because of the event-specific anniversary frame, not merely because the band is historically important.

events.factual_description: Sunrise Promotion presents Nobuo Hara and Sharps & Flats' 75th Anniversary — Nobuo Hara Centenary at I'M A SHOW in Yurakucho, Tokyo, on Friday, November 27, 2026, with doors at 5:00 PM and the concert at 6:00 PM. The official event bills Sharps & Flats and lists reserved seating at ¥8,800 including tax, with a separate drink purchase required. HARA Music Japan documents that Nobuo Hara founded Sharps & Flats in September 1951, that Hara died in 2021, and that the project restarted the band in 2024 around former members and its surviving arrangements and repertory. The current band project describes a 17-player live big-band format; individual personnel for the November 27 performance are not separately enumerated on the exact event page, so no member names are inferred for this record.

en.why_it_matters: This is Japanese jazz history being played rather than displayed. Hara started Sharps & Flats in 1951; after his death, the band was rebuilt around veteran players and the arrangements and repertory it had carried for decades. The November concert places that living inheritance inside two dates that meet only once: 75 years of the band and 100 years since Hara's birth. The appeal is hearing a big-band language that helped define postwar Japanese jazz passed forward by an ensemble deliberately built to keep it physical, acoustic, and collective.
en.trip_verdict: If late November overlaps with Tokyo, protect the evening in Yurakucho and build the night around this concert. Within a Kanto itinerary, the centenary date is worth choosing over a routine club booking because the historical frame disappears once the anniversary passes; it does not need to become a stand-alone transpacific trip to matter that strongly on the ground.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí la historia del jazz japonés no está en una vitrina: está tocando. Hara fundó Sharps & Flats en 1951 y, después de su muerte, la banda volvió a levantarse alrededor de músicos veteranos, arreglos y repertorio acumulados durante décadas. El concierto de noviembre junta dos fechas que sólo pueden coincidir una vez: 75 años de la banda y 100 años del nacimiento de Hara. Lo atractivo es escuchar cómo un lenguaje de big band que ayudó a construir el jazz japonés de posguerra se transmite en vivo, con una agrupación empeñada en conservarlo físico, acústico y colectivo.
es.trip_verdict: Si finales de noviembre coincide con Tokio, protegería esa noche en Yurakucho y armaría la velada alrededor del concierto. Dentro de un itinerario en Kanto, escogería esta fecha por encima de una noche de club más rutinaria porque el marco del centenario desaparece cuando pasa el aniversario; no necesita justificar por sí sola un viaje transpacífico para tener ese peso una vez estando allá.
